how_to_edit: The tavern's cut: when an adventurer comes home from their one expedition, the Hearth keeps cut% of the gold and the adventurer keeps the rest, then retires to Eros town for good.
cut% = min + the points below, kept between min and max. Everything here is read by scripts/game/hearth_cut.gd.
per_training_session: every session (a gain or a practice point) adds this, up to training_cap.
happiness: points by mood band at the moment they set out (names match data/upkeep.json bands).
room_quality: points for the room they sleep in (ids match data/lodging.json qualities).
per_suited_furnishing: each furnishing in their room that suits their class, up to furnishing_cap.
per_day_housed: each day since they joined, up to days_cap.

fame: recruit fame tiers. weights_by_establishment_tier[t] are the odds of each tier (in order) at Hearth tier t. Each tier multiplies the signing fee and adds stat_bonus to every attribute and level_bonus to level (when levelling is on).
